name: 无糖银罐冰蓝能量饮料款
description: 冷白银罐冰蓝点缀，空标靶承载无糖主张，整箱收口

styleLock.direction: cool premium sugar-free canned beverage commerce
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless cool white #FFFFFF sweep for packshots and the closing frame, brushed silver-blue #DCE7EE panel for benefit and info screens, cool near-white #F2F6F9 field for macro, sunlit foliage bokeh #2F5D3A allowed only inside the single lifestyle frame
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool high-key studio light near 6500K, broad front key that lays one crisp vertical specular streak on the aluminium shell, thin cool rim, soft short contact shadow, never warm tungsten
styleLock.surfaceSystem: glossy seamless white sweep, brushed cool-grey laminate #C9D4DC and matte pale stone #EAF0F4, no wood and no linen
styleLock.typography: one condensed geometric sans-serif in graphite #2B2F33 with at most one ice-blue #7FC3E8 highlight, every headline slot kept as an empty placeholder
styleLock.iconSystem: flat thin single-weight line icons in ice blue #7FC3E8, rounded rectangle and pill frames only, no 3D, no badge artwork
styleLock.presentationRules: the can stays upright at identical silhouette scale and centred mass in every frame, the shell always carries a blank information field instead of label artwork, carton shows blank side panels only
noDrift: no warm cream, milk-tea or lemon-yellow tones
no redrawn label artwork or claw-style graphics
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool premium sugar-free canned beverage ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless cool white #FFFFFF, brushed silver-blue panel #DCE7EE, ice-blue accent #7FC3E8 and graphite text #2B2F33; cool high-key studio light near 6500K with one crisp vertical specular streak on the aluminium shell and a soft short contact shadow; glossy white sweep and brushed cool-grey laminate surfaces only, no wood, no linen, no warm cream or lemon-yellow tones; one condensed geometric sans-serif kept as empty placeholder slots; flat thin-line ice-blue icons; stable upright can angle and scale with a blank information field on the shell; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no redrawn label artwork, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 在搜索结果缩略图里一眼赢下点击，只交代无糖银罐主体轮廓。

shots.lighting: cool high-key studio light near 6500K, broad front key with a thin cool rim, one crisp vertical specular streak on the shell, soft short contact shadow
shots.whitespace: none, the can fills the centre with equal clean margins
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce hero packshot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The can stands perfectly upright on a straight-on eye-level axis, seen dead front with the full body from base to lid inside frame. Cool high-key studio lighting near 6500K from a broad front key drops one crisp vertical specular streak down the brushed aluminium shell and leaves a soft short contact shadow under the base. Seamless cool white background #FFFFFF with no horizon line. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace beyond even clean margins. Negative: no brand wordmark, no claw-style mark, no readable label lettering, no printed digits of any kind, no props, no hands, no watermark, no gradient background, no cut-off edges, no plastic-looking food, no insects or contamination, no unrealistic portion size, no floating can without a contact shadow.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 冷白底单罐与撕口式多罐外包装同框，箱体破口处露出第二只罐；002 与 001 构图几乎相同，但箱侧换成第三方游戏联名广告并带扫码方块；003 竖幅单罐正面满幅，可见罐顶与拉环；004 一整页营养成分表，含成排的数值行、配料长句、产地与押金条目；005 冷白底单罐斜侧角度；006 户外绿植虚化背景中一名坐姿人物手持单罐，上衣胸口有醒目标识图形。品类判定依据：全部画面主体都是即饮罐装无糖能量饮料及其运输外包装，非器具、非营养补充剂，故 L1 取食品饮料、L2 取饮料，leaf 记为无糖罐装能量饮料；与提示的饮料方向一致，无需改判。已剥离内容：源品牌字标、系列名副标、源主标识图形与罐身花体装饰纹全部移除，罐身改为空白信息位；002 的联名广告与扫码方块整块剔除；004 的数值、成分名、容量与整箱只数一律不入稿，仅保留空表格与空印章框结构；006 的人物面容与衣着标识剔除，只留颈部以下与手部；整套不含平台角标与星级。与同轮茶柠檬汽水套图的区分：本套锁定冷白无缝背景加银蓝面板的影棚冷调体系，色板为冷白、银蓝、冰蓝、石墨炭，禁用奶茶米色、柠檬暖黄与木桌亚麻等暖调道具，背景体系也不同（影棚面板对比餐桌场景）。源图共 6 张，001 与 002、003 与 005 角色重复，合并后按转化漏斗排为 6 镜。
